explanation: Exact cos(theta*) endpoints -1 and +1 are integration poles that EXCLURAD cannot evaluate. They were replaced by the validated pole-safe values -0.999 and +0.999. The resulting five-point eta scan passed preflight at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg, using the validated eta campaign defaults Ebeam=6.53 GeV and vcut=0.166 GeV^2 with full O(alpha) radiative corrections.
